text:
Dana: Morning — quick bridge before I hand off. Wanted to run through the postmortem follow-ups from last night's 503 spike.
Miguel: Thanks — quick status: I pushed the cache-fix branch to canary at 03:10 UTC and rolled to 10% traffic. Haven't seen the eviction errors since. :thumbsup:
Priya: Can you paste the canary tag? I'll run the smoke tests against the canary routes.
Miguel: tag: inference-cache-fix-2026-03-14. Smoke commands: `curl -sS -H \"x-api-key: $KEY\" https://canary.redwood.internal/generate | jq .status`
Alex: FYI I validated KV hit/miss ratio in the canary logs for the sample workload — miss rate dropped ~42% over 30m window. Logs excerpt: ```json
{\"service\":\"kv-cache\",\"hits\":586,\"misses\":431}
```
Jordan: Nice. Two follow-ups from the postmortem board that still need owners: 1) add alert for sustained prefix eviction (SLO breach) 2) run a load test replicating user seq lengths > 2k.
Dana: I'll take (1) — will add a Prometheus rule and Slack alert (low noise threshold). Miguel/Alex can you confirm alert query matches metrics?
Miguel: I'll prototype the alert tomorrow AM and link PR.
Alex: I'll scope the load test and prep a k6 script, aim to run Thurs.
Priya: Quick check — should we re-open the incident ticket until the canary hits 100% and the alert is in?
Jordan: I'd prefer to leave it open as a P1 follow-up until mitigation is in prod and we've run the load test. Reopen if we see any regression during rollout.
Dana: OK reopening and adding the two action items with owners + ETA: alert PR by EOD tomorrow, load test by Thursday.
oncall-bot: Incident #3146 status changed to \"reopened\" by Dana — follow-up tasks assigned.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout for inference-cache-fix-2026-03-14 at 10% success: 98% requests healthy over 45m. Link: https://deploys.redwood/internal/rollouts/3146-canary
Miguel: I'll bump to 50% after the alert PR lands, then watch for any SLO dust.
Dana: Handing off to Priya for the day shift. Priya, any blockers from your side?
Priya: None right now, I will run the smoke and start the load test prep. Ping me for any anomalies.
Dana: Thanks team — leaving notes in the incident doc and the oncall board. :coffee:
